title: Field-proven Smart Control with safer hybrid reporting
titleId: Smart Control teruji lapangan dengan hybrid reporting yang lebih aman
summary: ARSAS 1.6.32 consolidates the field-proven IEC 61850 control path and the stabilized monitoring baseline. Smart Control now completes SBOw, Operate, positive CommandTermination and process feedback on the tested SIPROTEC using StationControl origin, while automatic full dynamic DataSet activation remains deliberately quarantined until G2 qualification proves a safe dynamic envelope.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.32 mengonsolidasikan jalur kontrol IEC 61850 yang telah terbukti di lapangan dan baseline monitoring yang distabilkan. Smart Control kini menyelesaikan SBOw, Operate, CommandTermination positif dan process feedback pada SIPROTEC yang diuji dengan origin StationControl, sementara aktivasi otomatis full dynamic DataSet tetap sengaja dikarantina sampai qualification G2 membuktikan envelope dynamic yang aman.
highlights: Field-proven SBO Enhanced control now preserves ordered SBOw and Operate wire evidence, positive CommandTermination, and process feedback correlation.
Manual workstation control uses StationControl origin and retains exact ctlVal, origin, ctlNum, T, Test and Check semantics across SBOw and Operate.
MMS TypeSpecification primitive-size constraints are decoded with signed semantics, preventing the IEC 61850 two-bit Check field from being misread as 254 bits.
MMS Write failures expose explicit DataAccessError names and numeric codes instead of collapsing IED rejection evidence into a generic write failure.
Static BRCB/URCB coverage remains report-first, while unsafe automatic full dynamic DataSet activation stays quarantined and residual points retain bounded MMS verification/fallback.
Reconnect handling is bounded and staged, with recovery warm-up and delayed report re-arm designed to avoid connection and polling bursts.
highlightsId: Kontrol SBO Enhanced yang telah terbukti di lapangan kini mempertahankan evidence wire SBOw dan Operate secara berurutan, CommandTermination positif, dan korelasi process feedback.
Kontrol workstation manual menggunakan origin StationControl dan mempertahankan semantik exact ctlVal, origin, ctlNum, T, Test dan Check pada SBOw dan Operate.
Constraint ukuran primitive MMS TypeSpecification didekode dengan semantik signed sehingga field Check IEC 61850 dua bit tidak lagi terbaca sebagai 254 bit.
Kegagalan MMS Write menampilkan nama DataAccessError dan kode numerik secara eksplisit sehingga evidence rejection IED tidak lagi hilang menjadi generic write failure.
Coverage static BRCB/URCB tetap report-first, sementara automatic full dynamic DataSet yang belum aman tetap dikarantina dan residual point mempertahankan MMS verification/fallback yang terbatas.
Reconnect ditangani secara bounded dan staged, dengan recovery warm-up dan delayed report re-arm untuk menghindari burst koneksi dan polling.
improvements: The ARSAS main branch is pinned to the exact reviewed ARIEC61850 G1.1 engine commit used by the successful physical control test.
Report projection remains fail-closed for ambiguous structured payloads; MMS verification stays authoritative when a report value cannot be mapped safely.
IEC quality evidence is preserved as received from the IED and is never cosmetically forced to Good.

Release packaging rebuilds the exact main source against the immutable engine lock, then runs regression tests, portable smoke, installer install/uninstall smoke, checksums, SPDX SBOM, provenance and GitHub artifact attestations before publication.
improvementsId: Branch main ARSAS dikunci ke commit engine ARIEC61850 G1.1 exact yang digunakan pada physical control test yang berhasil.
Projection report tetap fail-closed untuk structured payload yang ambigu; MMS verification tetap authoritative ketika report value tidak dapat dipetakan dengan aman.
Evidence IEC quality dipertahankan sesuai yang diterima dari IED dan tidak pernah dipaksa menjadi Good secara kosmetik.

Packaging release membangun ulang source main exact terhadap immutable engine lock, lalu menjalankan regression test, portable smoke, installer install/uninstall smoke, checksum, SPDX SBOM, provenance dan GitHub artifact attestation sebelum publikasi.
knownLimitations: Automatic full dynamic DataSet/RCB activation remains intentionally quarantined. G2 will qualify safe member counts, PDU budget and actual InformationReport delivery before production dynamic reporting is enabled.
Some vendor-specific structured report payloads still remain raw/fail-closed and therefore continue to rely on MMS verification until projector support is proven.

Full repeated network-outage acceptance of the staged reconnect policy remains a field-validation item even though the current build passed automated reconnect regressions and normal fast reconnect operation.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Aktivasi otomatis full dynamic DataSet/RCB tetap sengaja dikarantina. G2 akan mengualifikasi safe member count, PDU budget dan actual InformationReport delivery sebelum production dynamic reporting diaktifkan.
Sebagian structured report payload vendor-specific masih tetap raw/fail-closed sehingga tetap mengandalkan MMS verification sampai dukungan projector terbukti.

Acceptance repeated network outage penuh untuk staged reconnect masih menjadi item field validation walaupun build saat ini telah melewati automated reconnect regression dan normal fast reconnect operation.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai dan visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable EXE do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
